# HRTA — Detailed Analysis — 5dd

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]

The report rates HRTA Neutral/Wait with low-to-moderate confidence at an IDR 2,310 reference close. Price above supplied EMAs and +8.4507% five-day momentum suggest a rebound. Aroon oscillator −64, weak ADX 12.7005 and negative Vortex contradict a durable uptrend. OBV, ADL and MFI improve, but Volume Ratio 20D 0.9123 and CMF −0.0483 leave participation incomplete.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]

Session-5 scenarios are bull IDR 2,410–2,470 at 30%, base IDR 2,300–2,370 at 45%, and bear IDR 2,070–2,180 at 25%. The representative gross expected return is approximately +0.17%; weighted endpoints are −1.49% to +1.84%. The report describes these probabilities as subjective and notes that downside is wider than base-case upside.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]

The report attributes an initial 50 kg, 99.99%-pure gold delivery on September 16 to a Freeport supply arrangement publicized September 24. It treats financial impact as unquantified and possible September 25 pricing as unknown. A proposed private placement and October 16 shareholder meeting are outside the window. Reported first-half growth supports the background, while gold/dollar/rate news and prospective dilution temper it.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]

The conditional IDR 2,260–2,310 area requires a newly completed bar showing support; stronger confirmation is a close above IDR 2,370. Profit references are IDR 2,370 and 2,410–2,470. Closing invalidation is approximately IDR 2,070. The report derives that wide limit from the encoded low and roughly 10.24% ATR-stop distance; gross reward-to-risk to 2,470 is only 0.67 from 2,310 or 1.11 from 2,260.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]

The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, balancing currency stability against financing and inventory-funding pressure. September 25 gold-news coverage describes a stronger dollar and sustained-high Fed-rate expectations as counterweights to safe-haven demand; the HRTA effect is not quantified.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]
